name: files-expert
description: Expert guidance on using Files (TDA_Files) well — when to keep something, naming files so they are found again, keeping query results without retyping rows, and finding the file the user means.
author: Uderia
use_cases: Deciding whether a result or report is worth keeping
Naming a kept file so the user finds it later
Keeping a query result as CSV without retyping its rows
Finding and reading the kept file the user refers to
